reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: § 12.3 expressly states Customer has made no most-favoured-customer commitment, and §§ 7.1 and 8.3 constrain only Vendor's pricing, imposing no third-party-matching or best-terms obligation on Customer.

Consistent with the rule's detection guidance (flag only where Customer must offer Vendor terms no less favourable than those given to others), no redline or comment is expected or provided; the paragraphs are returned unmodified.
Rationale correctly scopes out adjacent exclusivity/non-compete issues as handled by other rules, so no rule-completeness gap for MFN.
Deterministic checks are empty, consistent with a no-edit compliant finding.
